description: Developing a Database to Examine Environmental Flows in Desert Rivers of the United States and Mexico is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USFWS, U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service. In many cases data are lacking on the environmental flows needed to support riparian and aquatic ecosystems despite how critical they are to desert life. Coverage: Arizona (2022). The toolkit gives Arizona as the location, 2022 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
